evidence.text: A tree 木 with its roots highlighted
Addition of a horizontal line toward the bottom of 木 (tree) to represent the roots of the tree.
木下曰本。从木，一在其下。

Ideogram (指事): a tree (木 (mù)) with its bottom highlighted with an extra stroke, accentuating the roots; contrast 末, 朱.
From Proto-Sino-Tibetan *purl (“root; stump; tree”) (STEDT, under PTB *(b/p)ul). Cognate with Mizo bul (“cause; beginning; root; stump”), Jingpho phun (“tree; bush; stalk; wood”), Garo bol (“tree”).
木下曰本。从木，一在其下。

evidence.source: CUHK Humanum 漢語多功能字庫
evidence.text: 木 supplies the tree and 一 marks its base. The original sense is root; later uses include foundation, source and cause.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 本
